{{/* Title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card, and WebSite JSON-LD. Site identity comes from data/site.json (the contract), not from Hugo config params. */}} {{- $site := hugo.Data.site -}} {{- $author := hugo.Data.author -}} {{- $isHome := .IsHome -}} {{/* A missing tagline must not printf a nil (renders "%!s()"). */}} {{- $home_title := cond (not $site.tagline) $site.name (printf "%s | %s" $site.name $site.tagline) -}} {{- $title := cond $isHome $home_title (printf "%s | %s" .Title $site.name) -}} {{- $desc := cond $isHome $site.tagline (.Params.excerpt | default (plainify .Summary | truncate 160) | default $site.tagline) -}} {{- $image := .Params.cover | default $author.avatar -}} {{ $title }} {{ range .AlternativeOutputFormats -}} {{ end -}} {{- if $isHome }} {{- $website := dict "@context" "https://schema.org" "@type" "WebSite" "name" $site.name "description" $site.tagline "url" site.BaseURL }} {{- end }}
